title: Tests autopilot go --scope gating, pause during integrate, and orchestrator up
acceptance: Each project's orchestrator can start swarm autopilot, and it starts go --scope when ready tickets exist, nothing is running, and the cap has room.
Autopilot pauses while the orchestrator integrates or runs e2e, and resumes after.
swarm orchestrator up (#206) keeps autopilot and the orchestrator running across restarts.

title: Tests integrated-tree snapshot handoff between dependent jobs
acceptance: A job that depends on an earlier integrated run receives a snapshot of the integrated tree automatically.
No orchestrator needs a local wip branch or a hand test run to pass state to a worker.

title: Extract board and watch commands into swarm-board module
acceptance: swarm.mjs is split into guard, scope, run, integrate, board, spend, lanes and cli modules with no behavior change.

title: CLI entry tools/swarm.mjs dispatches through swarm-cli after modular split
acceptance: node tools/swarm.mjs doctor exits 0 and lists lane probes after the modular split

title: Wire build-owns-tests rules into scope split ingest
acceptance: scope split --ingest accepts a build ticket that lists tests in its tests field without a separate test ticket.
The ingest report shows a shorter dependency chain than test-first splits.

title: Validate delete-only tickets and migration ticket DDL rules
acceptance: A delete-only ticket passes sync once its files are gone.
Rename and migration tickets have their own type with matching checks.

title: Wire event waits and flake quarantine into integrate check runner
acceptance: swarm integrate applies flake quarantine and surfaces quarantined checks in JSON status.

title: Parse verify.mode local in project profile and manifest builder
acceptance: verify mode "local" runs the ticket's tests itself with no agent and no tokens.

title: Persist learned per-lane concurrency caps per machine
acceptance: Learned per-lane caps are kept per machine.

title: Wire machine badges and version drift into the federated board overview
acceptance: The board at / lists projects from multiple machines with machine and version on each card.
Version drift is visibly flagged on /.

title: Expose fair slot sharing status on swarm status and board data
acceptance: swarm status reports each active project's priority share of machine slots.

title: Regression tests for e2e cleanup, localhost guard, and CI image cache
acceptance: E2e runs clean up their own local test data, and a local-only cleanup tool refuses non-localhost databases.
CI caches or mirrors images so Docker Hub rate limits don't fail runs.

title: Wire manager-commands into swarm.mjs main dispatcher
acceptance: swarm managers without a subcommand prints usage and lists manager subcommands.
